confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Tel Aviv price levels; no menus, booking pages, or listings were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable; hotel and hostel anchors are least certain because July rates depend on regional security conditions and tourism volume that I cannot verify. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer (about 1.7x and 1.3x) because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. Shekel prices were converted at an approximate, unverified ILS/USD rate. The FX value was read from rba.gov.au search snippets, not a directly opened table; confirm it on the live RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Loose regional basis: Middle East, benchmarked informally against high-cost Mediterranean tourist cities such as Barcelona and Athens, then adjusted upward for Tel Aviv's high restaurant, bar and hotel prices during July peak season.
